parts.provenance: Original work: the in-code header builder's construction (crates/solidcraft-integration/src/models/header.rs, retired with this file) made parametric in its counts, saved through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` at a 2 × 5 header of 2.54 mm; the header generator gives every parameter its value. Typical square-post proportions and estimated rounds; no vendor drawing or EDA/CAD library data copied.
parts.title: Straight pin header

parts.provenance: Original work, saved through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` at a 1 × 10 socket of 2.54 mm; the header generator gives every parameter its value. Proportions read as a datasheet from Würth Elektronik's WR-PHD 2.54 mm socket header drawing (61301011821, rev. 002.000, 2024-03-25: housing 8.5 mm high and 2.5 mm wide, tails 3.1 mm below the board); the openings and the contact's leaves are estimated. No vendor CAD or EDA/CAD library data copied.
parts.title: Through-hole pin socket

parts.provenance: Original work, saved through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` at a 2 × 3 socket of 2.54 mm; the header generator gives every parameter its value. Outline read as a datasheet from Würth Elektronik's WR-PHD SMT dual socket header, bottom entry, drawing (610006243021, rev. 002.001, 2022-01-28: housing 5 mm wide, top 3.7 mm and underside 0.2 mm above the board, tails 7.2 mm tip to tip); the openings, the contact's leaves and the tails' sheet are estimated. No vendor CAD or EDA/CAD library data copied.
